text:
mike: Quick heads-up — internal routing-policy header change (route-matrix v1 -> v2) lands in the proxy tomorrow. SDKs still emit the v1 matrix today; we need a compatibility/rollout plan.

tara: Do we have a backward-compatible wire format or a negotiation step? If not SDK customers will start seeing 400s or wrong routing.

carol: There is a compatibility field but the Console's quota attribution pipeline only reads v2 keys. If SDKs don't emit v2 we'll see gaps in dashboards.

simon: Short-term idea: SDKs emit both formats behind an opt-in flag (emit_v2). Console can translate v1->v2 for a grace period. Longer term we should consider an explicit negotiation endpoint. Example headers:
```
x-route-matrix: v1;routes=zone-a:10,zone-b:5
x-route-matrix: v2;routes=[{"zone":"a","weight":10},{"zone":"b","weight":5}]
```

tara: OK. Can we dual-write in python + ts with minimal perf impact? We should keep the default unchanged until we've had a canary.

carol: Payload size up a bit but negligible. Major risk is telemetry — console only tags v2. We'll add a translation layer and surface a "unknown-attribution" metric during the rollout.

mike: Proposed rollout: 1) add opt-in flag to SDKs (emit_v2=false by default) 2) console accepts v1 & translates to v2 for 2 weeks 3) canary (beta customers) -> regional canary -> global over 2 weeks 4) add telemetry tag `route_matrix_version` to all requests so we can monitor adoption and attribution. Any objections?

simon: :thumbsup: I'll start PRs for ts & py emitting both formats behind the flag. Go needs a tiny serializer tweak too, I'll ping @chuck.

devex-bot: deploybot: nightly build created for sdk-emit_v2 flag: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/7890 (tests running).

carol: Also add a dashboard tile showing the % of requests with missing attribution and a small alert if unknown_attribution spikes >5%. Support should get a note for likely customer questions.

tara: I'll draft release notes and a short code snippet for customers on custom proxies. Suggestion: include quick rollback steps (`export REDWOOD_EMIT_V2=false` or use client config).

mike: Cool — Simon/Tara can you pair tomorrow 10:00am PT to land the initial canary? I'll own console translation and the dashboard tile.

simon: Yep, on my calendar.

tara: See you.

mike: Thanks everyone — aim to avoid last-minute surprises.
